children: Investors are becoming more cautious and requiring higher premiums to invest in newly issued bonds, ING's Jeroen van den Broek and Timothy Rahill say in a note. High volatility in sovereign bond yields has led investors to demand around 10 basis points to 15 basis points of extra compensation on new credit issuances, they say. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
